status: A8 proposed owner-adapter seam; A0 approval required before production

authority.commit_owner: A0 transaction boundary using A3 item catalog and existing SaveService
authority.save_owner: A0 SaveService; A8 scene keeps no durable state

identity: intent_id = source_id + '|' + object_id + '|' + action_id + '|' + claim_id; claim_id is owner-stable and is suffixed by owner-projected generation for replenishable candidates.
request_rules: The sender proposes action/cost/reward data only; it cannot spend, grant, persist, or render a receipt.

The owner independently checks current actor, collision/access, action eligibility, capabilities, A3 item identity, inventory capacity, costs, exclusive site choice, claim idempotency and persistence.
One atomic owner transaction couples item debit/credit, claim ledger, cooldown/generation, site state and delayed action unlock timestamps.
Fixture authorities accept provisional_test_only=true only; production authorities must explicitly reject fixture intents and derive production costs/rewards from approved A3 data.
World state and visible results change only after an authoritative committed result; interrupted/rejected operations leave the unchanged projection available for safe retry.
The authority validates all requested state prerequisites and enumerated state-value branches against its own saved projection; the scene check is only early UX.
The owner projection carries resource_ready_at by stable object_id and its durable clock_seconds; the scene uses these only to render/deny early, while the authority is always final.
integration_note: This is a scoped S2 contract proposal, not a substitute A0 SaveService API. Version changes require a new contract file and an A0 migration/compatibility decision.
